goal: Preserve the prompt, quality target, output contract, cost receipt, and visual gate while allowing the transport or model provider to change.

same_model_alternatives.best_for: One-shot generation or editing with direct model selection.
requirements: OpenAI API project and server-side API key
the same prompt and visual acceptance gates

same_model_alternatives.best_for: Conversational or multi-turn image generation and editing.
same_model_alternatives.note: The mainline Responses model calls the image tool; GPT Image selection is handled by the tool and mainline token usage is additional.

different_model_fallbacks.use_when: A managed generation tool is preferred and exact underlying model identity is not required.
A different image model is acceptable after running the same baseline prompt and visual rubric.

different_model_fallbacks.transport: MuAPI, another declared provider, or an installed local image runtime
different_model_fallbacks.use_when: A lower-cost or specialized model clears the same prompt, rights, and visual acceptance contract.

failover_rules: A transport failure may fail over to the same model through another proven transport without changing the creative brief.
A model change is never silent; record the resolved model, provider, prompt hash, cost, duration, and fallback reason.
Do not publish a fallback image unless it independently clears the visual rubric and trademark boundary.
Do not claim two routes are equivalent until the same golden prompt is benchmarked through both.
Do not retry broadly: one targeted retry is allowed only for an unusable or contract-breaking result.
